description: This file appears to be a test script for a lighttpd server implementation in Perl. It performs extensive testing of HTTP request handling, including request parsing, response generation, header handling, authentication, request methods, range requests, chunked transfer encoding, and module-specific behaviors (such as mod_cgi, mod_deflate, mod_extforward). The script uses Test::More for assertions and interacts with a LightyTest class to start, stop, and perform requests against a lighttpd server setup in the test environment.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class used for testing the lighttpd server. It provides methods to start and stop server processes, perform HTTP request handling, and check server features within tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for LightyTest objects, initializes configuration and server test environment.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process for testing.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request as defined in the test input and checks the response from the server.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if specific server features (like zlib support) are available.
